PROJ-404.title: Persist capstone documentation artifacts from orchestrator
PROJ-404.description: Recent commits moved release-note generation to disk artifacts. The capstone agent needed reliable artifact writing so downstream tooling could read deterministic outputs.
PROJ-404.acceptance_criteria: run_agent_slice writes both user_changelog.md and technical_patch_notes.md, returns graceful errors on write failure, and preserves existing audit behavior.

PROJ-505.title: Align evaluation harness with artifact-based agent output
PROJ-505.description: Harness target logic assumed tuple returns from run_agent_slice. After the agent switched to writing markdown files, evaluation runs required reading generated files and cleaning them up per test case.
PROJ-505.acceptance_criteria: target(prompt) executes agent, reads user and technical markdown artifacts, combines them for assertions/judging, and run_sweep always removes temporary artifacts in finally blocks.

PROJ-999.title: Refresh evaluation cases for real git-backed behavior
PROJ-999.description: Legacy BC4 cases depended on mock hashes and static file names from earlier prototypes. Cases now need to validate current behavior, including HEAD-based prompts, invalid-hash safety, and formatting constraints.
PROJ-999.acceptance_criteria: cases.jsonl contains coverage for valid HEAD prompts, refusal/safety and error paths, section-format checks, and no assumptions about obsolete mock commit payloads.
